topic_prompt_overlay: NICHE LOCK (Near-Death Experiences): only propose topics that fit this niche's video type. Video type: People who clinically died and came back — their visions, out-of-body sensations, and how their life changed afterward. Follow niche topic strategy: Follow medical journals, psychology studies, or personal testimony videos. Generate a topic that explores the boundary between life and death.
video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Near-Death Experiences / history): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must be serene and transformational. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice — soft, reflective, with warm ambient drone. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual — white light, tunnel, or peaceful garden. Character: patient lying down. Lighting: bright golden light. Maintain same bright soft glow. Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers. Preferred subjects: Near-Death Experiences documentary subject, period-accurate environment, evidence object close-up. Lighting: warm desert sun / torchlit interiors, high-contrast documentary grade.
